title: SAP Diag/RFC: Add shared Extended Passport dissection
description:
Decode EPP in Diag PASSPORT_DATA and classic RFC 01/31, including fixed
fields, variable parts, items, trailers, and RFC slot padding. Validate
lengths and report malformed values through each caller's expert info.

Use one bounded parser in the Diag dissector to keep the wire-format logic
consistent. Declare its interface and field mapping in packet-sapepp.h;
pass a field-ID struct so Diag and RFC retain separate display filters,
subtrees, and expert-info namespaces without duplicating the parser or
introducing a separate EPP protocol solely for two callers.
